_about: App Store screenshots for the customer app, in English and Spanish. StoreScreenshots.swift takes each screen by the name on the left; scripts/app-store-frames.py lays out each frame. 'order' is the order on the App Store; the first three appear in search results. Photos are real jobs already on the website (images/real-*), each used once. Owner approves the words.
